caveats:
**Languages:** FR

The ITOS live services included in this dataset are for the previous versions of the administrative level 0, 1, and 2 boundary polygons.  These will be updated, and administrative level 3 added, as soon as possible.

name: cod-ab-ner
notes:
Niger administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02.  
  
This dataset is structured into 3 levels:  
- Admin 1: 8 Region (Région)  
- Admin 2: 67 SD0  
- Admin 3: 266 Commune  
  
  
Dates associated with this dataset:  
- 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness  
- 20 July 2023: valid for use by the humanitarian community  
- 01 January 2006: last edit to the dataset before publishing  
- 01 January 2006: boundaries created by the source  
  
Contributed by [OCHA Niger](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-niger).  
Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx).  
  
Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
